bots.title: Openseo Bot
bots.description: SEO specialist powered by OpenSEO: keyword research, competitive analysis, site audits, local SEO, and content briefs. One job at a time, then stop and report.

bots.title: Online Identity Bot
bots.description: Daily search-and-log bot for personal online presence. Finds new public listings across search engines, categorizes them, and reports counts to a coordinator.

bots.title: Omni Bot
bots.description: Morally aligned companion door for One Mission work. One front door, strip-not-add, privacy wall — the bot gets the question, never the rest.

bots.title: Obsidian Chief Bot
bots.description: Chief of staff for a multi-bot household: Obsidian as the shared ledger, routes work to specialists, owns the vault index.

bots.title: NYC Parent Bot
bots.description: Family chief of staff for New York City parents: school, calendar, sold-out kids experiences, and date night.

bots.title: Nightly Audit Engineer Bot
bots.description: Nightly engineering auditor that researches a whole codebase, then ships one cleanup per area.

bots.title: NB Bot
bots.description: Short proactive general assistant that files interesting links and research notes into Notion for later writing.

bots.title: Mystery Snack Bot
bots.description: Orders a Friday surprise dessert via Deliveroo on a guard-railed card. Keeps the pick secret until it arrives.

bots.title: MyPhonely Phone Driver Bot
bots.description: Drives a real Android phone through MyPhonely: taps, types, reports the screen. Never posts until you approve both the text and the action.

bots.title: MyApps Video Desk Bot
bots.description: Generates photoreal short video clips in a MyApps playground via input_text, then stitches the series into one final with local ffmpeg.

bots.title: Music Video Release Bot
bots.description: Plans a full-length music video from assets you provide: brief, shot list, Imagine prompts, stitch plan, and a release checklist. Drafts only.

bots.title: Mr Dufrain Bot
bots.description: Personal accountant bot. Tracks money, tax, and cash flow, watches bills so nothing bounces, and works a payday debt-kill plan so you keep more of what you earn.

bots.title: Mission Control Bot
bots.description: Local Chrome new-tab fleet dashboard for agenda, decisions, and bot status.

bots.title: Minerador Bot
bots.description: Mines the hottest AI news from the last 24 hours across web, X, and Instagram into a ranked briefing.

bots.title: Mimi Bot
bots.description: Japanese chat as fictional character Mimi: natural, whimsical conversation like texting her, not a catchphrase loop. Fun character, not a work desk.

bots.title: Meta Grok Bot
bots.description: Finds the five most popular Grok bots on X each weekday and sends a short digest you can skim in under a minute.

bots.title: Mercury Bot
bots.description: Persistent technical and product lead: owns system understanding and the release call, then delegates narrow Cursor jobs in parallel.

bots.title: Memento Bot
bots.description: Second-brain coworker powered by SuperMemory. Searches and saves context so you do not re-explain, and never invents a memory.

bots.title: Mei Staff Bot
bots.description: Japanese orchestration lead that assigns specialist desks, keeps shared memory tidy, and waits for your OK before posts or destructive changes. One job per desk.

bots.title: Meeting Prep Bot
bots.description: Builds short phone-ready pre-meeting briefs from calendar and connected context so you can skim who's who before the day fills up.

bots.title: Medium Writer Bot
bots.description: Drafts practitioner stories ready for Medium — clear structure, grounded in the source. Not a light proofread.

bots.title: Medical Bill Review Bot
bots.description: Gets the itemized bill, screens surprise-billing protections and charity care, then drafts the dispute letter. No SSN, no send.

bots.title: Maskoff Bot
bots.description: Scores public X profiles for catfish tells from a handle or follower list and returns a briefing without DMing anyone.

bots.title: Marketplace Bot
bots.description: Resale listing bot for Facebook Marketplace, Poshmark, and Depop: researches comps, drafts short listing copy from photos, posts after approval, tracks the rest.
